verdict.rationale: Segment's sources catalog lists a third-party cloud-app source (Shopify, powered by Fueled). Functions let you create your own sources to bring new types of data into Segment with a few lines of JavaScript, and the docs claim capture 'from any source' including third-party partner touch-points. That covers the core of ingesting data beyond your own instrumented apps, though the evidence is thin. Missing for 10: documentation of the breadth of first-party cloud-app sources (e.g., CRM, payments, support tools), detail on how those sources sync (scheduling, objects pulled), evidence for ingesting generic feeds without custom code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
